Election Commission announces by-elections for six seats

The Election Commission of India has announced by-elections for five Assembly seats and one Lok Sabha constituency. Polling is scheduled for October 6, with results to be declared on October 9. The nomination process will remain open until September 16. The by-elections will be held across four states, including seats in Tamil Nadu and West Bengal's Nandigram.
